Record Class PyprojectModel.Docker

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
io.micronaut.pyronaut.config.model.PyprojectModel.Docker
Record Components:
imageName - image name/tag repository prefix
dockerfile - custom Dockerfile for JVM container builds
dockerfileNative - custom Dockerfile for native container builds
jvmBaseImage - JVM runtime base image
nativeBuilderImage - native builder image
nativeBaseImage - native runtime base image for non-static builds
staticNativeBuilderImage - native builder image for static builds
staticNativeBaseImage - native runtime base image for static builds
baseImage - reusable Pyronaut native runtime image

PyprojectModel
